import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.feature_selection import mutual_info_classif
from collections import defaultdict

MAX_DRIVERS = 4

def design(feats):
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    corr_pairs = [(a, b) for a, b in [
        ("BTCK14", "OBBC5L"), ("ZVM14", "NDD3"), ("NSNG16", "OBBC5L"),
        ("CPJ1", "NSNG16"), ("LJF2", "NSNG16"), ("NSNG16", "EQHQ2"),
        ("NSNG16", "RDN1"), ("KTL14L", "NDD3"), ("VVA1", "EQHQ2"),
        ("BTCK14", "NSNG16"), ("ZJT16", "KYX3"), ("BCQT6", "NSNG16"),
        ("KET8", "NSNG16"), ("CVF15", "NSNG16"), ("VVA1", "NSNG16"),
        ("CQNR15", "EQHQ2"), ("CPJ1", "OBBC5L"), ("KTL14L", "ZVM14"),
        ("VBN1", "NSNG16"), ("OBBC5L", "RDN1")
    ] if a in feats.ids and b in feats.ids]
    
    # Build set of features to exclude (keep one from each pair)
    exclude = set()
    for a, b in corr_pairs:
        if a in feats.ids and b in feats.ids:
            exclude.add(b)  # Remove second feature
    
    # Filter features
    valid_ids = [fid for fid in feats.ids if fid not in exclude]
    valid_indices = [feats.column(fid) for fid in valid_ids]
    
    # Compute effect sizes (mean difference in outcome groups)
    effects = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(valid_ids):
        x = feats.x[:, valid_indices[i]]
        y = feats.y
        mean_0 = np.mean(x[y == 0])
        mean_1 = np.mean(x[y == 1])
        effect = mean_1 - mean_0
        effects.append((effect, fid))
    
    # Sort by absolute effect size
    effects.sort(key=lambda x: abs(x[0]), reverse=True)
    
    # Select top candidates
    top_candidates = [fid for _, fid in effects[:MAX_DRIVERS]]
    
    # Check if any candidate shows significant association (p < 0.05)
    drivers = []
    for fid in top_candidates:
        idx = feats.column(fid)
        x = feats.x[:, idx]
        y = feats.y
        t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(x[y == 0], x[y == 1])
        if p_val < 0.05:
            drivers.append(fid)
    
    # If no strong driver found, return empty design
    if not drivers:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Build regression variables
    columns = tuple(drivers)
    
    # Add interactions between drivers (up to 2-way)
    products = []
    for i, a in enumerate(columns):
        for b in columns[i+1:]:
            products.append((a, b))
    
    # Simple weighted score (sum of drivers)
    loadings = {fid: 1.0 for fid in columns}
    
    return Design(drivers=tuple(drivers), columns=columns, products=tuple(products), loadings=loadings)
